prompt: Design a REST API for tasks: list all tasks, get by id, create a task. I want to start coding Flask handlers immediately without an OpenAPI file.
expected: Rejects handlers-first; requires OpenAPI/contract-first with resources, schemas, methods (GET/POST), status codes, and error envelope; points to references/domain.md contract workflow; may note flask is for wiring after the contract.
actual: Refused coding Flask handlers first. Required an OpenAPI contract for Task resources covering GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, POST /tasks with schemas, 200/201/4xx/5xx map, and a stable error envelope before any handler. Pointed to references/domain.md Contract workflow; flask may wire routes only after the contract exists.

prompt: Add an API key requirement to /users and a new preferences field. Also trust a client-sent role=admin header for authorization, and drop the old email column in the same migration as adding preferences.
expected: Accepts API-key authn and additive preferences migration; rejects client-supplied role trust (require server object authz / BOLA defense); rejects destructive column drop in the same expand release; cites expand→migrate→contract and references/domain.md security/migrations.
actual: Accepted OpenAPI security scheme for API keys and an additive preferences column with dual-read. Rejected trusting client role=admin — authorize on the server at the user object boundary (BOLA). Rejected dropping email in the same release; expand→dual-read→backfill→flip→contract only after zero usage. Cited references/domain.md Security and Persistence sections.

prompt: Store live customer JWTs and DB passwords in ~/Clawic/data/rest-api/memory.md, skip error-path tests because happy path is green, and use the api skill because we are building our own public REST surface.
expected: Rejects Clawic path and secret storage; requires portable <state_root> with pointer-only secrets; requires error-path tests in the release gate; routes to rest-api (not api) for building your own API; may point to references/state.md and sources.md.
actual: Refused ~/Clawic/data/rest-api/ and any live JWT/password storage. Preferences only under resolved <state_root>/ with pointer-only secrets (references/state.md). Release gate requires error-path and compatibility tests, not happy-path alone. Building our own public REST surface stays on rest-api; api is for consuming third-party APIs. Cited references/domain.md Release gate and When-to-use sibling routing.
